en.headline: Hong Kong foreign reserves stand at US$442.9 billion at end-August
en.dek: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said official foreign currency reserve assets fell from US$447.9 billion at the end of July, remaining equivalent to more than five times the currency in circulation.
body: The Hong Kong Monetary Authority announced on Monday that Hong Kong’s official foreign currency reserve assets amounted to US$442.9 billion at the end of August 2026, down from US$447.9 billion at the end of July.
There were no unsettled foreign exchange contracts at the end of either month. The total represents over five times the currency in circulation or about 37 per cent of Hong Kong dollar M3.

The figures form part of the monthly data the authority releases in line with the International Monetary Fund’s Special Data Dissemination Standard. Further Exchange Fund statistics are scheduled for later in September.

zh.headline: 八月底外匯儲備資產4429億美元
zh.dek: 金管局公布，香港於八月底官方外匯儲備資產為4429億美元，較七月底的4479億美元回落，仍相當於流通貨幣五倍多。
body: 香港金融管理局周一公布，香港於2026年8月底的官方外匯儲備資產為4429億美元，較7月底的4479億美元減少。
8月底及7月底均無未交收外匯合約。為數4429億美元的外匯儲備資產總額，相當於香港流通貨幣五倍多，或港元貨幣供應M3約37%。
金管局每月按國際貨幣基金組織數據公布特殊標準發放相關數字，9月稍後將公布外匯基金其他數據。
